summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expands the dispatchable-generation power-island node with one obvious leader/context anchor and two discovery-lane names. The node appears tied to speed-to-power for AI/data-center loads, with evidence strongest for large reciprocating generator sets and backup-power systems. Underfollowed exposure is harder to prove: Broadwind is a speculative micro-cap supplier into combined-cycle gas-turbine and power-generation component chains, but customer concentration and segment mix require later verification. Layer 1B expansion focused on scarce dispatchable-generation and power-island suppliers rather than obvious hyperscaler or utility demand owners. The strongest underfollowed paths found in this pass are: newly public reciprocating gas-engine OEM exposure via INNIO, packaged electrical/power-control infrastructure via Powell Industries, and gas-turbine exhaust/emissions/acoustics systems via CECO Environmental. GE Vernova, Siemens Energy, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Caterpillar, and Cummins remain reference leaders/context anchors, but this pass avoids filling the candidate list with mega-cap or non-US-primary leaders. Layer 1B expanded the dispatchable-generation power-island node with a two-lane universe: GE Vernova as the obvious reference anchor for gas turbine slot scarcity and service backlog, plus underfollowed second-order names where the exposure hides in emissions/exhaust systems or distribution/service businesses rather than obvious AI, utility, or power-equipment labels.
